info.name: teachMe API
info.description:
REST collection for the teachMe tutoring marketplace API (Express + Prisma + Supabase).

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Demo accounts (run `npm run seed` in teachme-be/ first):
- Student: student@teachme.dev / Password123!
- Tutor: tutor@teachme.dev / Password123!
- Tutor: sarah@teachme.dev / Password123!
- Tutor: rafi@teachme.dev / Password123!

Start with the Auth folder (Login Student and Login Tutor) or run the E2E Happy Path folder to exercise the whole booking lifecycle.

request.description: Liveness probe. Public, no auth required.
Create an account. Password must be >= 8 chars with a letter and a number. Role is STUDENT or TUTOR.
Logs in the seeded student. Saves studentToken, refreshToken and userId to the environment.
Logs in the seeded tutor. Saves tutorToken to the environment.
Rotates the refresh token. The token is invalidated on use; reusing a revoked token revokes the whole family.
Revokes the current refresh token. Requires a valid access token.
Returns the current user with profile. Uses the collection bearer (studentToken).
Update display name and/or timezone.
Returns all subjects alphabetically. Saves the first subject id to subjectId.
Student-only. Filters: q, subjectId, minPrice, maxPrice, minRating, sort (rating|price_asc|price_desc|newest), cursor, limit. Saves the first tutor id to tutorId.
Full tutor profile: bio, verification, rating, subjects with pricing.

Paginated reviews for a tutor.

request.description: Tutor-only. Weekly availability rules (weekday 0=Sun..6=Sat, minutes from midnight).
Creates a weekly rule (Saturday 09:00-12:00). Saves ruleId.
Updates a weekly rule (Saturday 10:00-13:00).
Deletes a weekly rule. Rematerializes slots (booked/held slots are preserved).
Tutor-only. Blocked dates.
Blocks a date. Saves exceptionId.
Removes a blocked date and rematerializes slots.
Tutor-only. Own slots with status (for the schedule preview).
Tutor-only. Stats, incoming requests, upcoming sessions, needs-grading.
Tutor-only. Paginated ledger of completed bookings (gross, fee, net).
Student-only. Atomically claims the slot (OPEN -> HELD) and creates a PENDING booking. Saves bookingId.

request.description: Both roles. Own bookings; filter with status=PENDING|ACCEPTED|PAID|COMPLETED|REJECTED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED.
Booking detail with payment and events. Owner only.
Tutor-only. PENDING -> ACCEPTED, sets payBy (+2h) and creates a CREATED payment.
Tutor-only. PENDING -> REJECTED; frees the slot.
Student-only. Cancels a PENDING or ACCEPTED booking; frees the slot.
Tutor-only. PAID -> COMPLETED (requires slot.endsAt in the past). Creates a ProgressEntry and evaluates certificates.
Student-only. Review a COMPLETED booking once. Updates the tutor's rating average.
Student-only. Booking must be ACCEPTED. Returns mock charge info (orderId, methods, reference) and sets the payment to PENDING. Saves orderId.
DEV ONLY (disabled when NODE_ENV=production). Idempotently settles the payment: Payment SETTLED, Booking PAID, Slot BOOKED.
Student-only. Series of scores + summary (target, minSessions, completedSessions, average).
Student-only. Own enrollments with progress summary and certificate status. Saves enrollmentId and certificateId.
Student-only. Sets the learning target (target score and minimum sessions) per enrollment.
Student-only. Streams the certificate PDF (requires certificateId; available after a target is reached).
Public. Returns non-sensitive verification info for a certificate code.
Inbox with unreadCount. Uses the collection bearer (studentToken). Saves the first notification id.

item.name: E2E Happy Path
item.description: Runnable end-to-end chain using the seeded accounts. Run the requests in order (Runner) to exercise the full lifecycle: login -> discover -> book -> accept -> pay -> settle -> grade -> progress.

request.description: Requires the slot.endsAt to be in the past. If the slot is in the future this returns a conflict; use the seeded completed booking for a guaranteed COMPLETED transition.
